about: Curated, gated free music for RasanAI films. Built by hand from R3's survey; every FMA licence was re-read on the track's own page and every file URL returned audio and a SHA-256 when this was written. Nobody has listened to these yet (listened: false): mood and fit come from tags plus ffmpeg measurements. Verify again before release (README.md).

host_policy.self: CC0 / CC BY files. Fetched on demand from `url` (FMA's file server) for the three options shown, SHA-256 checked, and may be mirrored in RasanAI's own release assets: set `mirror` to the mirror URL and the runtime prefers it.
host_policy.upstream: Mixkit Free Music Licence. Never mirrored, never prefetched, never bulk fetched (Mixkit's terms ban scripts that mass download and making items available to third parties). Metadata and the Mixkit page only; the file is fetched from Mixkit's own URL once, when the user picks that track.

credit_forms.CC BY 4.0: Music: "<Title>" by <Artist> (<page>), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
credit_forms.Ketsa: adds (Ketsa.uk): the tracks are registered, and the credit in the description keeps the video claim-free
